text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka and I are at the special
summer training camp. It's held
every year
to help students prepare for the races
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: There are only a few days left of camp...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
This really is the perfect environment for
me to focus on my training.
I'll be sad to
bid it farewell.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that sounds good.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way, Trainer. About the
triathlon event...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The event that Silence Suzuka is referring
to has become something
of a tradition at
summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The triathlon features swimming, biking,
and long-distance foot races.
Participants
need a good command over their stamina
to win it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No... My specialty is with medium
distances after all, and I don't think
I'd be
able to keep up as a front runner for quite
so long...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um... Would it be okay if I tried anyway?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It might help me enjoy this last part of
camp to its fullest, like you
said.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Okay, thank you! I'll be sure to give it my
best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After signing up for the event, the big day
rolls around quickly.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
There are quite a lot of participants. I
wonder if this is part of the
training
regimen for some...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it's much the same for me. I only
intend to go at my own
pace from start to
finish.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No, I'm a runaway through and through.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um... Can I ask you a favor?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Do you think... you could get me another
reward?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Oh right, I heard that there was a
festival happening tonight.
Do you think
you could take me there?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Off I go, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So begins the first event of the triathlon.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Caster
text_block_list.text:
First, we'll have our contestants battlin'
the big blue! Seems like
smooth sailin'
today, but swimmin' against these waves'll
be tough!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Caster
text_block_list.text:
And it's Silence Suzuka with an early lead.
Land or sea, she doesn't
give up the front
spot!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Suzuka's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
But this is a triathlon, yeah? Shouldn't she
be saving her stamina?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the concerns of some, Suzuka is
easily able to pull away from
the
competition in both the swimming and
bike races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All that remains is the long-distance
contest.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Caster
text_block_list.text:
It all comes down to this! Silence Suzuka
still has the lead!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Caster
text_block_list.text:
But what's this? Signs of slowdown? The
pack is closing in on her!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I wait near the finish, I can see Suzuka
come dashing into view.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I don't think she has much left in the
tank...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
She should be able to hear us from here,
so let's bring her across the
finish! Go for
it, Suzukaaa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The triathlon is simply part of our training regimen, so maybe I shouldn't take it too seriously—but I can't help myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not entirely sure if she can hear my
voice, but that's no reason to
skimp on the
cheers.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: This scenery... It's mine alone!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Caster
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Silence Suzuka picks up speed once
again!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's pulling away from the pack! Look at
those legs go!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Caster
text_block_list.text:
Her lead unwavering, Suzuka crosses the
finish line! The winner of this
year's
summer camp triathlon is Silence Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That shaved ice was delicious! It was just
the thing I needed after all
that exercise
today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I can't bring myself to give up the view
from the lead in any race. But I
knew that
wouldn't be easy in a triathlon—that's why
I wasn't planning
to enter.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But then I realized that just like at the fan
event before, all I had to
do was clear my
mind and stop overthinking it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's thanks to your guidance and
encouragement that I'm now able to
do
that.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Very... And there's one more thing I
realized as well.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Silent scenery filled only with the sounds
of the wind and my own
beating heart... A
world with no one but myself in it was the
most
important thing to me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: But I think that has changed a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
A world with no one else in it... except for
you, waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you is all I need to muster up the
strength to win.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No matter the race, I'll always find my way
to the front... back to you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has clearly helped Silence
Suzuka not only to grow
athletically, but
also to more deeply experience her
emotions.
